title: Interview opening and birth in New Orleans
summary: Hardy gives his birth date and says he was born in the French Quarter and left around age seven.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: This is an interview on the 16th of January 1961 with Charles Hardy, who was born in New Orleans and who plays string instruments. And I've asked him to recall some of his earliest years. When were you born, Charles?
And what part of New Orleans were you born in?
I was born down in the old French Quarter.
Did you live there for any considerable time?
Well, we lived there until I was about seven years old. Then we moved, finally moved to Nashville, Tennessee.
